logical_fallacies.example: Dismissing someone's opinion on economic policy because they belong to a different political party.
logical_fallacies.location: The man faced a huge backlash after he skipped the queue to get off his flight when it landed - he feels he did nothing wrong as nobody was getting up.
logical_fallacies.explanation: The backlash against the man's action of skipping the queue is based on personal attacks and criticism of his behavior rather than addressing the specific issue of queuing etiquette.

logical_fallacies.example: Shifting the debate on climate change to economic costs without addressing environmental impacts.
logical_fallacies.location: One person wrote: 'What is it with people who stand up the minute the plane comes to a stop. You're not going anywhere anyway.'
logical_fallacies.explanation: The comment about people standing up when the plane lands diverts attention from the main issue of the man skipping the queue to an irrelevant point about waiting times.
